subject: Soft-landing plan for Alex Jenkins — Zoom pass, agenda, accessibility
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Wu <samantha@talentbridge.co>
Date: 2027-10-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Prep: Alex Jenkins (BrightByte) — virtual arrival & accessibility needs

Hi team,

We have Alex Jenkins (BrightByte) scheduled for onscreen interviews next Tuesday 10/18. I'm compiling a short "soft-landing" note we can send candidate and panel — want to confirm a few items before I send the candidate-facing email. Details below: 

- Role: Senior Backend Engineer (Platform) — onsite-virtual loop (remote candidate)
- Timeline (PST):
  - 09:30 — 09:40: welcome + recruiter intro (Sofia)
  - 09:45 — 10:45: system design (Lauren lead)
  - 11:00 — 11:30: take-home review / questions (Aditya)
  - 11:35 — 12:00: wrap + next steps (Marissa)
- Panel: Lauren, Aditya, Marissa (all internal)

Things I need from you: 
1) Confirm short one-line interviewer intros (title + what they'll focus on) so I can add to the candidate email.
2) Any AV/hosting needs? We should decide who will be host/handoff for the shared Zoom (I can be host but would like Marissa as backup).
3) Accessibility: candidate indicated they prefer live captions and verbal readouts of whiteboard diagrams. Do we have live captions reserved?

Attachments: AJ_resume_20271016.pdf (attached).

If I don't hear back by EOD I'll assume the panel is confirmed and will send the candidate the run-of-show + Zoom pass.

Thanks — Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Recruiter | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-17T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prep: Alex Jenkins (BrightByte) — virtual arrival & accessibility needs

Thanks Sofia — quick confirmations: 

- Interviewer intros (one-liners for candidate email):
  - Lauren Bishop — Staff SWE, system design & scalability questions
  - Aditya Rao — Engineering Manager, backend architecture + API reliability
  - Marissa Cole — Technical Program Manager, cross-team collaboration / hiring process questions

- Host: Sofia will create meeting; Marissa to be passed host role at start of system design slot so she can manage breakout/handovers.
- Live captions: yes — please coordinate with Aditya on booking vendor (we used LiveCaption last month and it worked well).

Also: please add a 5-minute buffer between interviews in the calendar to allow for notes and quick check-in. Can you share the draft candidate email when ready?

Cheers,
Lauren

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-17T10:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prep: Alex Jenkins (BrightByte) — virtual arrival & accessibility needs

Quick ops note — Alex submitted a short accessibility form this morning (attached). He prefers:
- Live verbatim captions (not auto only)
- A single point-of-contact for any audio issues during the loop
- If we use whiteboard, to have diagrams narrated linearly, not simultaneous chatter

Planned actions: I've requested a pro captioner via our events vendor (LiveCaption). They'll join as a participant and share a captions link; we'll also enable Zoom live transcript for redundancy. Marissa — can you be the audio POC during the session? I can be backup.

Attachments: captioning_request_form_jenkins.pdf

-Aditya
Engineering Manager
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@gmail.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Samantha Wu <samantha@talentbridge.co>
Date: 2027-10-18T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Your interview tomorrow — Zoom link, agenda & accessibility notes

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for scheduling with us. Please find the short run-of-show and access info for tomorrow (Tuesday, Oct 18). If anything below needs changing, reply and I'll update.

Join link (primary): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=softlanding
Passcode: 4217
Alternate (dial-in): +1 (408) 555-0132, Meeting ID 987 6543 210

Run of show (PST):
- 09:30 — 09:40 Welcome + recruiter intro (Sofia) — quick housekeeping
- 09:45 — 10:45 System design (Lauren) — whiteboard & Q&A
- 11:00 — 11:30 Take-home review / discussion (Aditya)
- 11:35 — 12:00 Wrap + next steps (Marissa)

Accessibility & AV notes:
- We will have a professional captioner joining the Zoom as a participant (LiveCaption). You'll also see Zoom live transcript enabled. If you'd like a private transcript after the session, let me know and we can provide it.
- Marissa Cole will be the audio POC during the sessions; ping her in chat if anything is off.
- If you'd like us to narrate diagrams more slowly or repeat descriptions, say so at any time.

Panelists (what they'll focus on):
- Lauren Bishop — Staff SWE, system design & scalability
- Aditya Rao — Eng Manager, backend architecture & reliability
- Marissa Cole — TPM, collaboration & hiring process

Attachments: AJ_resume_20271016.pdf (for your reference), panel-short-ints.docx

Calendar invite + Zoom badge are attached to the event; I left a 5-minute buffer between sessions for quick notes.

If there's anything else we can do to make tomorrow easier, please tell me — otherwise we'll see you at 09:30 PST.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Recruiter | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai

— Alex
